attributes.description: Direct nullness branch selection.
Evaluate a selected missing-value rule, including its explicit null treatment.
Shared text-selection shape; regex/literal/token/locale variants remain distinct. Trimmed can compose the two boundary tests.
Compare a value with a parameter; default-value and selected-code semantics remain distinct.
Literal/reference-set membership; the flag axis needs two disjoint sets plus residual. Reference-backed variants may use existence instead.
Length or member count followed by branch selection. LOB/document representation determines the actual expression.
Evaluate required-field presence; C03 first restricts to conditionally required rows.
Compute present count and eligible total, then classify; preserve empty-population policy.
One column, a composite key, or a record projection supplies the grouping tuple. Return every matching row; null grouping follows the approved definition.
Aggregate duplication evidence; key-candidate variant also checks required non-null key components.
Compute distinct cardinality at the declared grain; zero-candidate, null and group eligibility rules differ.
Reusable success/failure selection concept. Grammar, conversion target, date components and document syntax require separate Oracle expressions.
Compare available source information with converted/round-tripped information under the declared preservation rule.
Combine required structural rules. Ten-digit IDs and delimited-record grammars are separate parameterized contracts.
Compare a representation with a declared normalizer result; null-producing normalization needs explicit treatment.
Requires source bytes and an explicit encoding; cannot diagnose lost original text from a decoded string alone.
Compute character or byte length and compare with equality or bounds.
Measure lengths then classify their population distinct count; separate from per-row length checks.
Algorithm-specific check-digit/checksum computation.
Map characters to scripts then count distinct script-bearing classes.
Four branches, including no cased letters; locale rules are required.
Sign compares to zero; tolerance compares a chosen distance to a limit. Temporal/spatial distance requires additional expressions.
Numeric representation/grid operations. Even/odd only applies to integral values; precision/scale needs a separate expression.
Finite, infinity and NaN must use appropriate Oracle floating-point semantics.
Compare target with rounded or truncated source; transformation choice is explicit.
Shared comparisons; predecessor binding, paired columns and scalar cutoffs are distinct input variants.
Bound comparisons with explicit inclusivity and residuals. Effective periods allow declared open endpoints; four-way boundary classification remains distinct.
Compute a population extremum and classify rows; preserve ties.
Generate permitted interpretations and count distinct meanings; zero meanings is outside this pair.
Required date/time components or timezone evidence; depends on available representation/metadata.
Compare interpreted value to declared granularity.
Calendar extraction or joined business calendar supplies selected class.
Compute age/latency and compare; future/reversed events excluded according to approved scope.
Existence/absence in a designated population. Direction, input grain and filters matter; mapping to usable geography can need additional validity conditions.
Overlap or boundary adjacency between valid intervals; predecessor selection for succession is a separate stage.
Bind ordered predecessor then compare step/order or look up allowed transition. First rows stay outside paired tests.
Rank using a declared total order; reverse ordering selects latest.
Count matching records per source row, including zero; do not conflate with distinct related entities.
Resolve matched reference/version and test its validity at the relevant time. Unknown validity is indeterminate.
Classify known reference statuses into declared disjoint sets.
Deduplicate entity-pairs, compute left/right degree maxima, then classify the observed nonempty relationship population.
Count eligible subjects with missing required matches; H04 starts from the expected domain.
Compare aligned values or derived/authoritative results. Normalization, tolerance, determinacy and correspondence must be preserved.
Compute aligned aggregates and compare to control or counterpart within declared tolerance.
Lookup selected policy/mapping; unknown policy or source is not automatically a negative result.
Compare attributes within the same entity/scope/time group.
Domain-specific rule body supplied by a human; lifecycle/eligibility interpretations remain separate.
Select current vs superseded inside complete eligible version chains; future versions excluded.
Interpret explicit soft-deletion encoding; not physical deletion detection.
Apply reference-system bounds to coordinate components.
Use declared spatial relation and boundary policy.
Spatial validity assessment depends on geometry representation and Oracle capability.
Compute frequency and compare with threshold or modal maximum; keep tied modes.
Chosen statistic/baseline determines per-value inlier/outlier selection.
Shared final comparison stage only. Dispersion, distribution compatibility, drift, entropy, association and representation require their own measurements and baselines.
Count selected rows then compare with zero or specified bounds.
Both/source-only/target-only or current-vs-history membership; population alignment and direction are explicit.
Compare occurrence counts for aligned keys or record projections across extracts.
Inspect parent assignment/child edges/incident edges; declared parent assignment differs from a successfully resolved parent.
Cycle membership, reachability and depth require distinct traversal variants; cycle membership is not mere reachability from a cycle.
Compare subject identifier and non-null referenced identifier.
Parse and access a path; missing path, JSON null, node type and SQL NULL remain distinct.
Evaluate selected structural constraints on a parsed document.
Presence of qualifying evidence; does not infer a passing outcome.
Imported schema facts are authoritative inputs. Different declarations/statuses/snapshot properties require distinct field expressions; SQL may be unnecessary.
Compose determinate component results on a common population; conditional rule restricts to antecedent-true subjects.
